entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Good evening.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Do you remember anything from the[n]moment you took the medicine[n]until now?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Hm, by the look in your eyes,[n]I'd say you don't.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You briefly woke from your coma,[n]but you were completely dazed[n]during the entire examination.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...You eventually lost consciousness,[n]and fell back asleep.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Are you out of your mind? Only an idiot[n]would have drank that.
I'm not outta my mind.
It's for my exams.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Fine. By the way, the reason you lost[n]consciousness was because of the taste.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It produces a foul smell when it[n]mixes with gastric juices, similar[n]to surstromming.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Oh well. All that matters is that thanks to[n]you, I was able to get some good data.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Okay, it's my turn to make good on my[n]part of the deal. That's why I waited until[n]you woke up.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I don't want the general public to[n]know about my original medicines.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: So, you're strictly prohibited from[n]disclosing what happens here to[n]anyone... Understood?
Of course.
Same goes for you.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Then it's a deal.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: As long as you come here for it,[n]I'll give you the medicine at a[n]good price whenever you want.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I may even add additional selections,[n]in time.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...I look forward to your continued[n]patronage.
I've made a deal with Takemi...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: So... when can you come back for[n]the next clinical trial?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Oh, you don't remember that part, either?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Well, I was saying that teenage test[n]subjects are quite valuable in the[n]medical research industry.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: So I'll provide you the medicine for your[n]entrance exams, and in exchange you'll[n]be my guinea pig.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...I have to perfect this medicine.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: If you're able to move now,[n]you can go home.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: All right, take care.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Considering all the actions you've taken,[n]you must've had someone with medical[n]expertise.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Who? And how did you treat[n]your wounds?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It'll be easy to find out who if we[n]look into this, you know!

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You have agreed to a new contract.[n]Excellent.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You shall benefit from the miracle[n]drug that strengthens your body.
